{{Top|leg}}
The '''Demon's Blood''' ritual was a tradition among the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. For the ritual, members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who were seeking enlightenment would track a [[sand demon]] out into the deserts in order to anoint themselves with its blood, and those [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who successfully returned then visited the Tusken Raiders in order to learn their own unique path to self-discovery.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Nomen Karr]]'s [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jaesa Willsaam]] was observed conducting a strange [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ritual at a Sand Demon [[Sand Demon's Cave|cave]] by [[Darth Baras]]'s [[Sith spy|spy]] [[Sharack Breev]]. Afterwards, Baras's [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] was sent to Tatooine to find Jaesa Willsaam. The [[Sith Warrior]] was directed by Breev to [[Izzeebowe Jeef]], who revealed that Willsaam had conducted the Demon's Blood ritual. Jeef informed the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] to undertake the rite as well.<ref name="Demon's Blood">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Seek Answers|Tatooine}}</ref>
